text:
maria: quick check — we're seeing SDK surface a generic `APIError` for streaming failures, and logs don't show request_id. For error handling we should map status codes to concrete exceptions and always attach the server `x-request-id`. thoughts?
kevin: +1 on mapping. I'd map 401/403 -> AuthError, 429 -> RateLimitError (include `retry_after`), 5xx -> ServerError with `retryable=true` maybe. streaming: we should emit a `StreamClosedError` when the connection drops mid-kv.
sophie: For streaming quirks: often a 200 + `event: error` shows up in the SSE body instead of a status code. SDK needs to parse event payloads and normalize into exceptions with the same fields (code, message, request_id). Suggest the server include `request_id` in every SSE event header/payload.
jordan: sample Python mapping I sketched:

```py
# pseudocode
resp = client._http_call(...)
if resp.status == 401 or resp.status == 403:
    raise AuthError(resp.text, request_id=resp.headers.get("x-request-id"))
if resp.status == 429:
    raise RateLimitError("rate limited", retry_after=resp.headers.get("retry-after"), request_id=resp.headers.get("x-request-id"))
if resp.status >= 500:
    raise ServerError(resp.text, retryable=True, request_id=resp.headers.get("x-request-id"))
```
sam: pinging @kevin and @sophie for a quick code review on the mapping change — want this in the next patch since prod logs are noisy. :eyes:
kevin: I can review later today. Also: ensure exception objects expose `.request_id` and that our logging middleware logs `request_id` at info level with correlation id. Example Go shape:

```go
type APIError struct {
    Code string
    Msg string
    RequestID string
    RetryAfter int // seconds, optional
}
```

and return `var ErrRateLimit = errors.New("rate limit")` with fields set.
sophie: small note — for streaming clients, surface partial-ish output vs complete: when we raise StreamClosedError include `last_offset` and `request_id`. This lets callers decide whether to retry or stitch.
maria: agree. Action items: 1) SDK: add explicit exception mapping + attach `request_id` property (kevin) 2) Runtime: ensure `x-request-id` header on all responses and SSE events (infra/rt) 3) Devex: add a small doc blurb showing code patterns for handling StreamClosedError and RateLimitError (sophie)
sam: I'll open the PR and mention reviewers.

maria: thanks — please include unit tests that assert request_id flows through exceptions and logs. I'll merge after review. :+1:
